jobs.occupation: Scientist for Attosecond and Structured X-ray FEL R&D (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:Scientist for Attosecond and Structured X-ray FEL R&DRemuneration Group 13 | Limited: 3 years | Start: 01.06.2027 | ID: MMA060/2026 | Deadline: 25.11.2026 | Full-time/Part-timeDESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.The European XFEL is one of the world's leading free-electron laser facilities, providing intense X-ray pulses with durations down to the attosecond regime. Further development of existing capabilities and exploration of novel approaches are pursued within the joint virtual FEL R&D group of DESY and European XFEL. The position focuses on the development of advanced FEL schemes for generating and controlling attosecond and structured X-ray pulses, with particular emphasis on orbital angular momentum (OAM) and the manipulation of temporal, spectral, and transverse radiation properties. The work combines theoretical studies, numerical simulations, and experimental demonstrations at the European XFEL. The successful candidate will also have opportunities to develop and pursue new ideas for advanced X-ray pulse generation and control.About your role:- Develop and optimize novel FEL schemes for attosecond and structured X-ray pulse generation, particularly OAM and advanced attosecond XFEL concepts- Perform numerical simulations of electron-beam dynamics and FEL radiation using codes such as GENESIS, Puffin, SIMPLEX, or comparable tools- Plan, prepare, and conduct beam studies and experiments at the European XFEL to demonstrate and characterize advanced FEL operation modes- Analyze experimental data, compare measurements with simulations, and contribute to commissioning, optimization, and operational activities at the facility- Present and publish scientific results, collaborate with international research partners, and contribute to the development of new FEL conceptsAbout you:- University degree in physics, accelerator physics, or a closely related field- Strong background in free-electron laser physics, accelerator physics, or a related area, with a good understanding of FEL processes and electron-beam dynamics- Experience with numerical simulations of FELs or particle accelerators, preferably using established simulation tools- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international and interdisciplinary research environment- Experimental experience at an XFEL or ariofher accelerator-based photon facility, including beam studies or commissioning activities- Previous involvement in research on attosecond X-ray pulses, orbital angular momentum, structured X-ray radiation, or other advanced FEL concepts- Experience in analyzing and interpreting FEL experimental data and comparing results with numerical simulations- Familiarity with FEL simulation codes such as GENESIS, Puffin, or SIMPLEX, and with advanced methods for manipulating the temporal, spectral, or transverse properties of X-ray pulses- Good written and spoken English communications skills, German is an advantageGood reasons to join:Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our staff are central to us, with gender equality forming a key part of this commitment. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. jobs.description: Fachkraft für Pferdewirtschaft & Stallmanagement (m/w/d) — PferdewirtInternational Title: Equestrian Specialist & Stable Manager (m/f/d) — Horse Care & Customer ServiceDEUTSCHER PROFILTEXT (Für das Portal der Arbeitsagentur):Für unseren professionellen Pensionspferdestall mit 60 Einstellplätzen im Rhein-Main-Gebiet suchen wir im Rahmen des Fachkräfteeinwanderungsgesetzes eine erfahrene und qualifizierte Fachkraft für das Stall- und Kundenmanagemen.Ihre Aufgaben: Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung und Überwachung der täglichen Fütterungs-, Pflege- und Mistsysteme nach strengen Betriebsvorgaben (Fütterung strikt nach visueller Heulinie)  professionelle Betreuung und Kommunikation mit unseren anspruchsvollen Einstellern; Überwachung der Pferdegesundheit und Organisation des Weidemanagements.Ihr Profil: Nachweisbare, mehrjährige Erfahrung im professionellen Pferdemanagement (idealerweise aus großen internationalen Reitsport- oder Polo-Zentren, z. B. Dubai); hervorragendes Gespür für Pferde und Tierwohl; fließende Englischkenntnisse (Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil).Besonderheiten & Erwartungen in Deutschland: Die Arbeitskultur in unserem Betrieb basiert auf absoluter Zuverlässigkeit, Pünktlichkeit und exakter digitaler Zeiterfassung. Das im internationalen Vergleich (insb. zu den Golfstaaten) sehr attraktive deutsche Gehalt und die soziale Absicherung sind kein Zuzugs-Bonus. Diese Vergütung wird durch das Tragen von echter Eigenverantwortung, ein hohes Maß an Eigenmotivation und die Fähigkeit, das System ohne ständige Überwachung fehlerfrei am Laufen zu halten, verdient.Was wir bieten: Eine strukturierte 6-monatige Einarbeitungs- und Qualifizierungsphase auf unserem modernen Hof mit festem Unterhalt und voller Unterkunft; anschließende langfristige Festanstellung.INTERNATIONAL / ENGLISH VERSION (For Agencies in India/Dubai):Responsibilities: Independent execution and monitoring of daily feeding, care, and mucking systems according to strict company protocols (feeding strictly to the visual hay line); professional care and communication with our demanding horse owners/boarders; monitoring horse health (early colic detection) and pasture management.German Work Culture: Absolute reliability and precise compliance with our established system without constant supervision. The very attractive German salary and social security compared to the Gulf States (e.g. Dubai) requires real personal responsibility, high motivation, and flawless work according to standards.We offer: A structured 6-month onboarding phase on our modern estate with a fixed stipend and full accommodation; followed by long-term permanent employment.
